breakdown.description: Both RAS and LES models are defined in `turbulenceProperties`. An OpenFOAM simulation cannot be both RAS and LES simultaneously; one must be chosen.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly resolved the inconsistency by selecting only one turbulence modeling approach. It explicitly states to use the Reynolds-Averaged Simulation (RAS) approach with the k-Epsilon model and does not mention the conflicting LES model, thus creating a valid simulation setup.
